data.summary_en: AlphaBet trains a single LLM policy via reinforcement learning with multi-date forecasts to search, reason, and report probabilities, scored by a proper scoring rule on final outcomes; on GLM-4.5-Air, Forecast-Dojo's Brier score falls from 0.731 to 0.626 and FutureX's from 0.612 to 0.528.
